page_title: HOF 3-4 WER | Hoffenheim v Werder Bremen 29/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+6' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Oliver Baumann makes a great save to stop his effort.
90+4' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
90+3' It looks like Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) saw red with that tackle. Tobias Reichel won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
90+3' Tobias Reichel shows a yellow card to Tim Drexler (Hoffenheim), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

90+1' Tim Drexler (Hoffenheim) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
88' It is time for a substitution. Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) is on for Marvin Ducksch.
88' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
87' The percentage of ball possession is – 42:58.
86' Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
84' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
83' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) takes the free kick from mid-range, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. What a miskick! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.

81' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.

81' The opposition back off Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort low towards the middle of the goal, but Michael Zetterer denies him with the save.
78' The main referee, Tobias Reichel, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) is given a yellow card for dissent.
77' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Senne Lynen trots off the pitch and is replaced by Skelly Alvero (Werder Bremen).
76' Romano Schmid comes off the pitch to be replaced by Keke Topp (Werder Bremen).
76' It's time for a substitution. Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) comes on in place of Derrick Kohn.
76' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim) replacing Pavel Kaderabek.
73' The game is interrupted now, Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
73' A yellow card for a tackle by Jens Stage (Werder Bremen). Tobias Reichel doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
72' This shall not pass! Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
71' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
69' Substitution. Marius Bulter did his best and is replaced by Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim).
65' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is out of play. Werder Bremen will have a throw-in.
63' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
62' Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

60' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The ball is out of play. Werder Bremen win a corner kick.
58' Ole Werner is forced to make a change. Niklas Stark is unable to continue due to injury, Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) comes on.
58' Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
56' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
55' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
53' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
52' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.

49' 3 - 4 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Mitchell Weiser is pounced on by Jens Stage (Werder Bremen). His close-range strike flashes past Oliver Baumann and into the bottom right corner. 3:4.
48' A dangerous looking corner kick from Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is cleared to safety by the defence.
48' Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Werder Bremen will take a corner.
47' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) sends the corner into the box, but Michael Zetterer intercepts it and averts the threat.

47' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
46' Pellegrino Matarazzo decides to make a substitution. Florian Grillitsch will be replaced by Anton Stach (Hoffenheim).
46' Alexander Prass will be replaced by Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Tobias Reichel has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Referee Tobias Reichel has finally had enough of Pellegrino Matarazzo and brandishes a yellow card at him!
45+2' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' 44:56 – the ratio of ball possession.
41' Tobias Reichel interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen).
39' 3 - 3 Goal! Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:3.
38' Werder Bremen work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

37' Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) attempts to turn the rebound in from close range. Nevertheless, the goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save and stops the ball from hitting the net. Great goalkeeping. The referee signals a corner kick to Werder Bremen.
36' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
33' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
32' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
31' 3:4 – this is the current number of shots on target.
28' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
27' That's the end of the game for Mergim Berisha, who is replaced by Tim Drexler (Hoffenheim).
26' 3 - 2 Goal! Marvin Ducksch plays a hopeful cross into a crowded box. Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) times his jump perfectly and sends a header inside the left post from close in. 3:2.
26' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

26' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Oliver Baumann makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the roof of the net. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Werder Bremen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
25' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block.
22' The foul by Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Tobias Reichel.
21' 3 - 1 Goal! Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 3:1.
20' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

20' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the top of the net, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Oliver Baumann. The ball is out of play. Werder Bremen will have a chance to score from a corner.
18' That was really pointless! Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim) made a mindless challenge and the referee Tobias Reichel showed him a red card.

17' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just over the crossbar. It could have been a fantastic goal! The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
16' Tobias Reichel blows for a foul after Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
16' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen).
12' 3 - 0 Goal! Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top of the net. It's 3:0.
12' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) serves up a nice cross, but Michael Zetterer punches the ball away.
12' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
10' What was Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
10' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
8' 2 - 0 Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Michael Zetterer with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:0.
7' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
5' 1 - 0 Goal! Mergim Berisha gets to the ball, slips Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) into the area and he scores with a delightful chipped finish to make it 1:0.
4' The foul by Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) was seen by Tobias Reichel who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
3' Michael Zetterer comes off his line to intercept the corner from Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim).
1' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
1' The match has just started.
Werder Bremen will kick-off.
Tobias Reichel will referee today's match.
